description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Physical Mutation

You can, with a successful Challenging (+0) Endurance Test, transform yourself into a swarm of small creatures to overwhelm your foes, traverse obstacles or slink away from an impending defeat. A fumbled roll results in a Minor Miscast. The transformation takes 1 Round. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.E2Es82TvBKa7CoDG]{Swarm} Creature Trait while in swarmform. You retain the same amount of Wounds when you turn into a swarm. Killing individual members of your swarm will reduce your Wounds; 1 Wound per Size (Little) creature and 1 Wound per every 2 Size (Tiny) swarm creatures. When you reform your body will be injured by an equal amount. If your swarm is split up when you reform, the parts that aren’t present will die immediately as they transform into decimated chunks of flesh and bone. Only one of your creatures has to survive for you to be able to reform yourself. Consult the table below to determine what manner of creatures your swarm consists of. The main difference between the different types of creatures is how they can move. The GM will determine if your swarmform creature is Size (Little) or Size (Tiny). You can only gain this mutation once.
